GeneDef.label: witcher toxin tolerance
GeneDef.description: The first witcher mutagens harden the blood against poisons. Carriers gain 40% resistance to toxic buildup from all sources - venom, toxic fallout, pollution, and the violent toxicity of witcher potions. Their quickened metabolism also flushes existing toxins away faster than a normal body. Strong, but far from immune.

GeneDef.label: witcher toxin tolerance
GeneDef.description: Deeper mutation reworks the liver and kidneys to purge toxins faster. Carriers gain 60% resistance to toxic buildup from all sources and clear lingering toxins from the bloodstream noticeably faster. A witcher can drink several potions before the poison overwhelms them.

GeneDef.label: witcher toxin tolerance
GeneDef.description: A master witcher's biochemistry routes around nearly all known toxins and metabolizes them rapidly. Carriers gain 75% resistance to toxic buildup from all sources and purge existing toxins quickly, letting them sustain regular potion use - though chugging brews in quick succession is still lethal.

GeneDef.label: witcher toxin tolerance
GeneDef.description: The additional mutagens push toxin filtration to the edge of what a body can survive. Carriers gain 85% resistance to toxic buildup from all sources and burn off lingering poison extremely fast. A mutated witcher can drink potions like water - but enough poison, fast enough, will still kill even them.
